reviewStatus: Drafted from verified sources; pending independent clinician review before clinical release.
commonErrors: Using the score as a surgical decision.
name: Tomita Score

version.label: Tomita score (Tomita et al. 2001)
version.detail: Three factors, 2–10. The original paper linked score ranges to surgical strategies; those strategies are not reproduced as recommendations.

purpose: Prognostic scoring for patients with spinal metastases.

calculatorNotice.title: Score only
calculatorNotice.message: Higher scores were associated with shorter survival. The original treatment-strategy groupings are not presented as recommendations.

resultStates.label: Tomita {total}
resultStates.summary: Higher scores were associated with shorter survival in the derivation series.
resultStates.detail: Group-level association; integrate with oncology input and current treatment options.

clinicalContext.text: A three-factor prognostic score for spinal metastases.

clinicalInsights.text: Tumour growth categories reflect the era of derivation; modern therapies may change behaviour.

limitations.text: Derived before many modern systemic therapies.

limitations: Growth categories require clinical judgement for less common primaries.

confounders.effect: Affects visceral and bone metastasis assessment.

guideSections.what: A 2–10 prognostic score from primary tumour growth, visceral metastases and bone metastases.
guideSections.whenToUse: Prognostic description in spinal metastatic disease.
guideSections.howToPerform: Score the three factors and sum.

sources.citation: Tomita K, Kawahara N, Kobayashi T, Yoshida A, Murakami H, Akamaru T. Surgical strategy for spinal metastases. Spine. 2001;26(3):298-306.
